title: The processed Sanguisorba officinalis L. triterpenoids prevent colon cancer through the TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, combined with network pharmacology, molecular simulation dynamics and experimental verification.
authors: Gan, Chunli; Mu, Yuanqiu; Ali, Shah Syed Faizan; Shi, Xuepeng; Jiang, Shuang; Wang, Zhengyang; Wu, Xiaotian; Wang, Xiaotong; Wang, Zhibin; Zhang, Shulu; Feng, Zheng; Yang, Chunjuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究地榆三萜类化合物通过TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB通路预防结肠癌，虽含分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Sanguisorba officinalis L. (S.L.), a traditional Chinese medicine from the Rosaceae family, is recognized for its rich content of triterpenoids, which are known for their antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-tumor properties. Although its traditional uses and biological activities are well known, its role in preventing colon cancer and the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. This study aims to elucidate the preventive mechanisms of triterpenoids in both raw (TR) and processed (TP) forms of S.L. against colon cancer. METHODS: The AOM/DSS-induced mouse model of colon cancer was employed to elucidate the mechanism underlying the preventive effects of Sanguisorba officinalis L. triterpenoids (ST) against colon cancer. A comprehensive suite of techniques, including hematoxylin-eosin staining (H&E), immunohistochemistry (IHC), TUNEL staining, Western blotting (WB), and DNA methylation analysis, was utilized to investigate the preventive effects of ST on colon cancer. The main active compounds were identified using UPLC-Q-TOF-MS, and potential active compounds were screened through network pharmacology and molecular docking. The stability of the protein-ligand complexes was further assessed using molecular dynamics simulations. RESULTS: In vivo experiments, treatment with ST significantly improved the clinical manifestations, Disease Activity Index (DAI) scores, and pathological lesions associated with colon cancer, with all drug administration groups outperforming the model group. Additionally, ST markedly enhanced gut barrier function by downregulating the levels of TNF-alpha, p65, COX-2, and iNOS. Furthermore, ST dramatically ameliorated the colonic immune-inflammatory state, which was associated with decreased expression of proliferative proteins and increased expression of apoptotic proteins. Among the identified triterpenoids, compound 27 May be the main active compound. Notably, compound 27 can form a stable complex with TNF-alpha. CONCLUSION: These results suggest that TP has a more pronounced colon cancer prevention effect than TR. TP play a role in preventing colon cancer by down-regulating TNF-alpha and thereby inhibiting the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. This research not only fills the mechanism gap of S.L. in the field of colon cancer prevention, but also provides methodological support and theoretical foundation for its transition from traditional Chinese medicine to clinical practice through the integration of multi-disciplinary technologies and the verification of precise targets.
abstract_zh: 背景：地榆（Sanguisorba officinalis L.，S.L.）是一种蔷薇科传统中药，以其富含三萜类化合物而闻名，这些化合物具有抗氧化、抗炎和抗肿瘤特性。尽管其传统用途和生物活性已广为人知，但其在预防结肠癌中的作用及潜在机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在阐明地榆生品（TR）和炮制品（TP）中三萜类化合物预防结肠癌的机制。方法：采用AOM/DSS诱导的小鼠结肠癌模型，阐明地榆三萜类化合物（ST）预防结肠癌的潜在机制。运用包括苏木精-伊红染色（H&E）、免疫组织化学（IHC）、TUNEL染色、蛋白质印迹（WB）和DNA甲基化分析在内的综合技术手段，研究ST对结肠癌的预防效果。利用UPLC-Q-TOF-MS鉴定主要活性化合物，并通过网络药理学和分子对接筛选潜在活性化合物。进一步采用分子动力学模拟评估蛋白质-配体复合物的稳定性。结果：在体内实验中，ST治疗显著改善了与结肠癌相关的临床表现、疾病活动指数（DAI）评分和病理损伤，所有给药组均优于模型组。此外，ST通过下调TNF-α、p65、COX-2和iNOS水平，显著增强肠道屏障功能。进一步地，ST显著改善结肠免疫炎症状态，这与增殖蛋白表达降低和凋亡蛋白表达增加相关。在已鉴定的三萜类化合物中，化合物27可能是主要活性化合物。值得注意的是，化合物27能与TNF-α形成稳定复合物。结论：这些结果表明，TP比TR具有更显著的结肠癌预防效果。TP通过下调TNF-α进而抑制NF-κB信号通路，发挥预防结肠癌的作用。本研究不仅填补了地榆在结肠癌预防领域的机制空白，而且通过多学科技术整合和精确靶点验证，为其从传统中药向临床实践转化提供了方法论支持和理论基础。
